mogdops-mod.welcome.page1.title: Overview & Concepts
mogdops-mod.welcome.page1.text1: Welcome! MogDop's Mod is a Garry's Mod style sandbox toolkit and WorldEdit extension.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page1.text2: It combines building tools, entity editors, custom item generators, and world controls into clean UI screens.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page1.text3: All building actions support full Undo and Redo history.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page2.title: Multi-Tool & Selection Axe
mogdops-mod.welcome.page2.text1: Left-Click sets Pos 1; Right-Click sets Pos 2 or adds polygon vertex points.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page2.text2: Hold Alt and scroll mouse wheel to smoothly expand or contract the targeted selection face.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page2.text3: Hold Ctrl and scroll mouse wheel to switch Multi-Tool modes (Selection, Remover, Explosion, Teleport, Spawner, Schematics, Images).
mogdops-mod.welcome.page2.text4: Visual 3D wireframe outline renders dynamically in world space with custom config colors.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page3.title: Radial Quick Action Bar (Key H)
mogdops-mod.welcome.page3.text1: Hold H to open the 360-degree radial Quick Action Bar.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page3.text2: Move mouse around the circular layout; 3D cube cursor smoothly tracks your selection.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page3.text3: Includes //set, //replace, Undo, Redo, Walls, Outline, Stack, Drain, and Clear Selection.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page4.title: Selection Modes (Key J)
mogdops-mod.welcome.page4.text1: Press J to open the WorldEdit Selection Mode wheel.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page4.text2: Cuboid Mode: Standard 2-point box selection (pos1 & pos2).
mogdops-mod.welcome.page4.text3: Poly Mode (2D): Multi-point 2D polygon with vertical Y extrusion.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page4.text4: Convex Mode (3D): 3D convex hull wireframe bounds defined by point vertices.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page5.title: Spawner & Mob Editor (Key ~)
mogdops-mod.welcome.page5.text1: Press ~ (Tilde) to open the Spawner GUI with live 3D entity models.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page5.text2: Mob Editor: Customize names, visibility, gravity, silence, glowing, baby status, slime size, and fire ticks.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page5.text3: Spawn customized entities instantly or export them into the Multi-Tool Spawner mode.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page6.title: Item Creator & Player Cheats
mogdops-mod.welcome.page6.text1: Item Creator: Modify item names, max stack sizes, durability, unbreakable status, and enchantments.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page6.text2: World & Player Tabs: Toggle Day/Night, Weather, Survival Flight, Speed III, Strength III, and clear status effects.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page6.text3: Entity Killer Tab: Scan and purge nearby entities by type or UUID.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page7.title: Mob Spawner Slab & Config
mogdops-mod.welcome.page7.text1: Mob Spawner Slab: Functional block for automated entity spawning. Right-click to open configuration screen.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page7.text2: Configure mob ID, spawn interval (sec), max active limit, spawn radius, and active toggle.
mogdops-mod.welcome.page7.text3: Type /md settings to adjust UI theme color, opacity, chat hiding, and selection particle settings.
